</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

representing 4500000.0 GBP in ARR [i:0fc6cb6155656fe2][i:10727c617a1f4506][i:3fa3eaf44b4d7c2f][i:71de0c62620ee6ab][i:d8352b80a8797730][i:f51ad41373d3cadc]\n- Linnet House Insurance, Saltmarsh Specialty, Brackwater Homecover, Marrowgate Commercial, Cindermill Trade Cover and Thistlecombe Mutual have all reported garage estimates landing in correspondence [i:0fc6cb6155656fe2][i:10727c617a1f4506][i:3fa3eaf44b4d7c2f][i:766f9ca2be319649][i:d8352b80a8797730][i:f51ad41373d3cadc]\n- The issue has been raised through 3 routes: account_management, support and onboarding [i:0fc6cb6155656fe2][i:10727c617a1f4506][i:71de0c62620ee6ab]\n- 1 renewal falls within the next 90 days, for Marrowgate Commercial on 2026-12-12 [i:766f9ca2be319649]\n\n## Evidence\n\n- is uploaded it lands in correspondence, that this is a wrong document category, and that handlers keep missing key evidence because of it, which delays claims resolution [i:a3f2a53f98cd8130]\n- Marrowgate Commercial reported that when garage estimates are uploaded they land in the wrong document category, like under Correspondence, and that the team has to manually move them, which risks things slipping through the cracks [i:766f9ca2be319649]\n- Cindermill Trade Cover reported that uploaded documents sometimes end up misfiled, with garage estimates tagged as correspondence, and that handlers have to move them manually, which risks missing critical evidence [i:d8352b80a8797730]\n- Thistlecombe Mutual reported that the document upload system keeps assigning the wrong category, such response.content: {"critique": "I checked all quantitative claims against the fact sheet: 6 accounts, 14 mentions, 3 routes (account_management, support, onboarding), GBP 4,500,000 ARR, and 1 renewal within 90 days (Marrowgate Commercial, 2026-12-12, GBP 1,600,000 ARR) all match exactly. The evidence bullets are paraphrases presented without quotation marks and accurately reflect the cited insight quotes, including the Marrowgate insight 71de0c62620ee6ab which correctly notes the lockout and Claims Tasks issues as unrelated. The only mild stretch is listing Thistlecombe Mutual as reporting 'garage estimates landing in correspondence' when its cited quote mentions 'repair quotes under correspondence', but the brief's own evidence bullet paraphrases this correctly, the fact sheet includes Thistlecombe among the affected accounts, and no cited contrary evidence is omitted.","verdict": "pass"}
